about.title: About--
about.p1: {app} is a system designed to help plan kayaking trips. Over the years, it has been continuously developed and improved.
about.p2: Some of the information stored in the system has not been verified, but much of it is based on trips that have already been paddled. No guarantee is made as to the accuracy of the data. Especially when out on the water, you must always be very careful and should never blindly rely on information provided by others.
about.p3: Some of the information shown here is based on the documents "{doc_link}" by {author_link}. These highly recommended documents can be downloaded from the website of {club_link}. Many thanks to Jens and his friends for this great work.

admin.lighthouse_import.title: Lighthouse import
admin.lighthouse_import.hint: Entries of the official lighthouse lists (Dansk Fyrliste, NGA List of Lights), read in with bin/import-lighthouse-list.php. Combine filters, select entries and import them as lighthouse POIs.
admin.lighthouse_import.conflict_intro: These international numbers already exist ({count}). Please decide for each lighthouse:
admin.lighthouse_import.conflict_in_sele: more than once in the selection
admin.lighthouse_import.conflict_hint: Add creates another lighthouse. Overwrite replaces name, description, position, characteristic and sectors of the (oldest) existing lighthouse (owner, visibility and photos are kept). Skip leaves everything unchanged.
admin.lighthouse_import.sector_missing_r: At least one sector has no range in the list; the default range set at import is used.
admin.lighthouse_import.default_ranges: Range when the list gives none (nautical miles):
admin.lighthouse_import.default_ranges_h: Applies to sectors without a range; the lighthouse's description then names the values assumed.
admin.lighthouse_import.transfer_hint: Exports all entries of this list to a file that can be read in again on another system (e.g. production). Entries already imported there stay marked as imported.
admin.lighthouse_import.confirm_load_fil: Read {count} entries from "{name}"? Existing entries with the same number and position are updated.
admin.lighthouse_import.file_invalid: The file is not valid JSON.
admin.lighthouse_import.area_hint: Press "Draw" and tap corners onto the map (from 3 corners on the area works as a filter), end with "Done". Afterwards corners can be dragged; dragging the midpoint of an edge makes a new corner. The area applies in addition to the other filters.
admin.lighthouse_import.area_no_key: The map is not available: no Google Maps key (MAPS_API_KEY) is set up or Google Maps could not be loaded.
admin.lighthouse_import.area_too_many: An area can have at most {max} corners.
admin.lighthouse_import.osm_hint: Fetches the lights (OpenSeaMap tags) of an area through the Overpass API into the list (source "OpenStreetMap"); then filter and import them like the other entries. At most 10 x 10 degrees per request, one request every 30 seconds. Data © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).
admin.lighthouse_import.osm_area_missing: Please enter south, west, north and east as numbers.
admin.lighthouse_import.osm_label_missin: Please enter a name for the area.
admin.lighthouse_import.osm_result: {fetched} lights found: {inserted} new, {updated} updated, {skipped} skipped (not navigation lights).
admin.lighthouse_import.nga_hint: Fetches one volume of the NGA List of Lights (Pub. 110-116) from NGA's Maritime Safety Information web service into the list (source "NGA (web service)"), with positions to the second. Note: this data is maintained through corrections and can be older than the monthly PDF edition (some lights are gone there by now, others are new). One volume per request (2-9 MB, a few seconds).

admin.lighthouse_duplicates.title: Lighthouse duplicates
admin.lighthouse_duplicates.hint: Finds lighthouses that lie close together - for example one drawn by hand and the same one imported from a list. For each group choose which entries describe the same lighthouse and what to keep.
admin.lighthouse_duplicates.hide_differe: Hide groups with different int. numbers
Applies to groups with an imported lighthouse in which all have an int. number and not all the same one. If at least one has no int. number the group stays visible.
admin.lighthouse_duplicates.only_with_ma: Only groups with a lighthouse that was not imported
Hides groups in which every lighthouse was imported.
admin.lighthouse_duplicates.choose_hint: Tick "Merge" (at least two per group). Then choose which record stays and, for each row, which record the value comes from. The photos of the others are taken over (at most 5), their lighthouses are deleted.
admin.lighthouse_duplicates.no_groups: No lighthouses found that close together.
admin.lighthouse_duplicates.take_from_th: Take the value from this record
admin.lighthouse_duplicates.confirm_mess: Merge {rows} groups? {deleted} lighthouses will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
admin.lighthouse_duplicates.merged_resul: {merged} groups merged, {deleted} lighthouses deleted, {moved} photos taken over, {dropped} not taken over (maximum).

admin_user.title: Users
admin_user.search_placeholder: Search by name, username or email
admin_user.invite_hint: The user will receive an email with a link to set their own password.
admin_user.admin_desc: Full access to everything - overrides every other right and all ownership checks (e.g. editing other users' tours, even without "Manage").
admin_user.tour_create_desc: Allows creating tours, plus editing and deleting the tours this user has already created themself.
admin_user.tour_publish_desc: Allows publishing this user's own tours (then visible to other users).
admin_user.tour_manage_desc: Allows editing, deleting and managing the tours of ALL users, not just this user's own.
admin_user.tour_copy_desc: Allows copying any tour this user can view (own, public, or - with "Manage" - anyone's) into their own account.
admin_user.route_view_recording_desc: Shows when/how long a GPS-recorded route was recorded, and by whom. Without this right these fields stay hidden - even from the route's own owner.
admin_user.export_routes_own_desc: Allows downloading one's own routes (from their context menu) and one's own tours (tour details) as a GPX 1.1 file.
admin_user.export_routes_public_desc: Allows downloading every public route and every public tour (including other users' ones) as a GPX 1.1 file. One's own private routes and tours are covered by "Export own routes". Independently of this, the export can be opened to everyone in the settings.

watch.title: Garmin watch
watch.load_failed: Could not load the watch status.
watch.not_paired: No watch is paired. Create a watch key and use it to build the YTAN data field for your watch.
watch.direct: In the app the route is sent straight to the watch - no key needed. The watch needs the YTAN data field (the build for the app, bin\build-watch.bat app) and a running activity with that data field.
watch.direct_also: In the app the route is also sent straight to the watch - that works without the key too.
watch.route_not_reached: "{name}" could not be sent to the watch directly. Is the watch connected? Start the activity with the YTAN data field on the watch and send the route again.
watch.token_hint: The key is only shown now. Pass it when building the data field (bin\build-watch.bat) or use the settings file below.
watch.settings_file_hint: Settings file for the watch: it contains the key, so a data field without a built-in key (bin\build-watch.bat app) is enough. It stays here until you create a new key. Rename the downloaded "ytan-ReplaceByWatchName.SET" to the name the watch itself created in GARMIN\Apps\SETTINGS after the data field's first start (e.g. ytan-fenix7pro.SET) and replace that file. End the activity first and restart it afterwards.
watch.settings_file_missing: There is no settings file for this key (it predates the feature). Create a new key and it will be available here.
watch.settings_file_failed: The settings file could not be downloaded.
watch.no_route: No route on the watch yet. Open a route and tap the watch icon.
watch.regenerate_confirm: A new key invalidates the old one - the installed data field then has to be rebuilt. Continue?
watch.unpair_confirm: Unpair the watch? The installed data field will no longer receive routes.
watch.route_is_current: This route is on the watch (send again)
watch.route_sent: "{name}" was sent to the watch. It picks up the route when the activity starts, or within 5 minutes if it is already running.
watch.route_sent_now: "{name}" was sent to the watch and will be there in a few seconds.
watch.route_not_synced: This route isn't saved on the server yet. Send it to the watch once you're back online.
watch.colors_hint: The waypoint marker has the direction's color. The watch picks up the colors on its next sync (when the activity starts, otherwise every 5 minutes). Watches with fewer colors (e.g. Fenix 6) round to the nearest color they can show.
user.default_speed_hint: The ETA on the Garmin watch starts from this value until it has measured speeds (after about 5 minutes of paddling only the measurement counts). Empty or 0: the ETA only appears after 30 seconds of paddling.
error.auth.default_speed_invalid: The speed must be between 0.5 and 30 km/h.
